metadata.case_name: KONG LAI MEI v. YU WING FONG AND OTHERS

injuries.description: Crushed injury at her right heel with degloved skin loss to her heel pad and the medial ankle region. The underlying tendons and muscles of her right heel were exposed and badly damaged.
source: She was diagnosed to have sustained crushed injury at her right heel with degloved skin loss to her heel pad and the medial ankle region. The underlying tendons and muscles of her right heel were exposed and badly damaged.
injuries.icd_description: Crushing injury of other parts of foot

injuries.description: On account of the skin grafting operation she had an 18 cm x 23 cm scar on her right thigh and a 10 cm x 19 cm skin grafted area on her right calf.
source: On account of the skin grafting operation she had an 18 cm x 23 cm scar on her right thigh and a 10 cm x 19 cm skin grafted area on her right calf.
injuries.icd_description: Open wound of hip or thigh

manifestations.description: Mild impairment of motor power of her right ankle (ankle weakness)
Decreased sensation on her right calf at the skin graft area; poor sensation over her right heel and sole region
Could walk for about 200 to 300 meters with special rocker bottom boot; needed a crutch for prolonged walking; walked with a limp
Traumatic emotional reaction including distress when being looked at in public, nightmares and insomnia
Dysthymic disorder (chronic depression of mood: depressed mood, low self-esteem, embarrassment, nervousness when being looked at, lack of interest in activities, insomnia)
Fear/anxiety when seeing an excavator and being afraid to go back to the place of the accident

treatments_received: Debridement on the day of admission
Reverse posterior tibial artery fasciocutaneous flap and skin grafting on 16 May 1997
Further debridement and skin grafting on 3 June 1997
Contact weight bearing orthosis for protection of flap
treatments_future: Defatting operation to remove subcutaneous fat from skin flap (estimated cost HK$50,000)
Psychological/psychiatric treatment sessions (Dr SIU recommended 8 one-hour sessions estimated at HK$28,000)

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities (physical impairment from crushed right heel and related surgeries) assessed by the court at HK$500,000.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Used to enjoy dancing and swimming but since the accident she could no longer participate in her usual activities.
Patches of unsightly scars on her right leg and ankle cosmetically unacceptable to her; she felt embarrassed about her scars and distressed when being looked at in public.
Mobility limitation: able to walk with a special rocker bottom boot, walked with a limping gait, required an elbow crutch for long distance ambulation and had difficulty climbing stairs.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Engaged a domestic helper from September 1997 to October 1998 to assist with household duties.
